reasonJa: Occurrence rationales at 20:4 and 27:11 incorrectly described these verses as continuing genealogy. The pinned WEB depicts a battle at Gezer in 20:4 and a monthly military division captain in 27:11. Correct only the internal rationale strings.

changes.beforeReasonJa: 父子関係の継続する系譜記述として直接名が記される。
changes.afterReasonJa: 歴代誌上20:4は、ゲゼルでのペリシテ人との戦いでシベカイがシップパイを討ったと記す。
changes.fixedWEBText: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

changes.beforeReasonJa: 父子関係の継続する系譜記述として直接名が記される。
changes.afterReasonJa: 歴代誌上27:11は、第八月の部隊長をシベカイとし、その部隊の二万四千人を挙げる。
changes.fixedWEBText: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
